items.title: The Phoenix Suns have waived Haywood Highsmith, league sources told HoopsHype. He was partially guaranteed $1 million of his $3 million salary for the 2026-27 season. The 3-and-D forward has averaged 5.4 points on 38% 3-point shooting and 3.1 rebounds in six NBA seasons.
items.author: Michael Scotto
